query: How do I apply for a Master's degree?

response.answer:
Based on the provided context, you can apply for a Master's degree at HTW Berlin via one of two application portals:

1. If you obtained your first academic degree in Germany or are a national of an EU/EEA country, you should apply through the HTW application portal (https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-the-application-portal-of-htw-berlin/masters-study-programmes/) during the applicable winter or summer semester. The application periods are:
	* Winter semester: 16 May - 15 June
	* Summer semester: 15 November - 15 December
2. If you obtained your first academic degree outside Germany and are not a national of an EU/EEA country, you should apply through uni-assist (https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/) during the applicable winter or summer semester. The application periods are:
	* Winter semester: 2 April - 15 June
	* Summer semester: 1 October - 15 December

Please note that specific deadlines may apply to certain study programmes, so it's essential to check the Eligibility and Admission Regulations for your chosen Master's study programme.

You can find more information on the Master's application via the HTW application portal or uni-assist by visiting the respective links provided in the context.

query: What documents do I need to submit with my application?

response.answer:
Based on the provided context, it seems that you are asking about the required documents for your application. According to [Source 2 - WEB], Required Documents, you will need to submit:

* Overview of all grades (grade transcript) with current date of issue and confirmed by the examinations office of your university(s) with an official stamp and signature
* Proof of current/last completed subject semester

Additionally, if you are a refugee, you may also be required to provide one of the following documents as proof:

* Certificate of registration as an asylum seeker (Bescheinigung über die Meldung als Asylsuchender — BÜMA)
* Temporary residence permit (Aufenthaltsgestattung) in accordance with Section 55 AsylVfG in conjunction with Section 63 AsylVfG
* Residence title granted on the basis of international law, humanitarian or political grounds as defined in sections 22 to 26 of the German Residence Act (AufenthG)
* Refugee travel document, based on Article 28 of the Geneva Convention
* Temporary suspension of deportation (Duldung) as defined in Section 60a of the German Residence Act (AufenthG)

Please note that these documents may be required for refugees only. For more information, you can visit [Source 5 - WEB], Refugees: Pathways into studying.

Remember to submit your application documents as officially attested copies or with an officially attested German or English translation if necessary.

query: What are the admission requirements for international students?

response.answer:
According to the provided context, the admission requirements for international students at HTW Berlin are as follows:

* For admission to a Bachelor's degree programme, you require:
	+ A general higher education entrance qualification or a subject-specific higher education entrance qualification or specialist entry qualifications in accordance with § 11 of the Berlin Higher Education Act
	+ Or a recognised foreign higher education entry qualification (Source: [Admission requirements](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/admission-requirements/))
* For admission to a Master's degree programme, you require:
	+ A recognised first academic degree
	+ Study programme-specific requirements (e.g. proof of language proficiency, professional experience)

It is also mentioned that some study programmes have additional requirements, such as:

* International Business (Bachelor) and Cyber Security Business (Bachelor): No additional proof of English language is required for applicants who obtained their qualification from English-speaking OECD countries.
* Some Master's degree programmes require a first academic degree with 210 ECTS. If you only have a degree with 180 ECTS, you can request accreditation of professional experience after your first academic degree and/or subject-specific modules in the amount of the missing 30 ECTS.

Please note that admission requirements may vary depending on the specific study programme you are applying to. I recommend checking the relevant website for more information (Source: [Master's study programmes](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-the-application-portal-of-htw-berlin/masters-study-programmes/)).

If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to ask.
